opportunities.name: Movie night invite: IMDb + Rotten Tomatoes lookup, then email
opportunities.description: For a given movie, find its IMDb rating, director and runtime and its Rotten Tomatoes Tomatometer score, then write an email to a friend inviting them to watch it on a given day.
steps: Open imdb.com and dismiss the cookie banner if it appears
Type {movie_title} in 'Search IMDb' and press Enter
Click the matching title in the results, then note the IMDb rating, director and runtime
Open rottentomatoes.com and reject the cookie banner if it appears
Type {movie_title} in Search and press Enter
Click the matching movie and note the Tomatometer %
Open the mail compose form and set To = {recipient_email}
Set Subject = 'Movie night {day}: {movie_title}'
Set Body = 'Hi {name}, {day} we watch {movie_title} ({director}, {runtime}): IMDb {imdb_rating}, Tomatometer {tomatometer}%.'
Send the email (in the recording it was discarded instead)

instances.values: Spirited Away; tom@example.com; Saturday; IMDb 8.6, Tomatometer 96%
The Grand Budapest Hotel; IMDb and RT lookups only, no email seen

opportunities.name: npm package health check logged to notes
opportunities.description: For a given npm package, collect its version, weekly downloads and license from npm and its stars, open issues and latest release date from GitHub, then save a one-line summary to Notes.
steps: Open npmjs.com and type {package} in 'Search packages', then press Enter
Click the exact-match package in the results
Note the version, weekly downloads and license
Click the GitHub repository link
Note the stars and open issues, then click Releases and note the latest release date
Open Notes and type '{package}: v{version}, {downloads}/week, {license}, {stars} stars, {issues} open issues, last release {date}' in 'New note'
Press Enter to save

opportunities.name: Recipe and dish-origin note
opportunities.description: For a given dish, open the top Allrecipes recipe to get its rating, time and key ingredients, look up the dish's place of origin on Wikipedia, then save a summary to Notes.
steps: Open allrecipes.com and type {dish} in 'Find a recipe or ingredient', then press Enter
Click the top recipe result and close any modal
Note the recipe name, rating, total time and first ingredients
Open wikipedia.org and close the donation banner if it appears
Type {dish} in 'Search Wikipedia' and press Enter
Note the 'Place of origin' from the infobox
Open Notes and type '{dish} for {servings}: {recipe} ({rating} stars, {time}), needs {ingredients}. Origin: {origin}' in 'New note'
Press Enter to save
